acceptance: Each test uses a machine name unique to the test (for example derived from tmp_path), so concurrent workers never match each other in the in-use scan.
The four tests pass repeatedly under pytest -n auto.
description: tests/unit/test_heavy_choke_points.py runs scripts/linux_machine_run.sh against a fake machine named "m". benchbox/utils/linux_machine.py:455 leaves the machine running when it finds another live `linux_machine_run.sh m` or `container machine run ... m` process on the host. Under pytest-xdist, another worker running the same tests matches, so the stop is skipped and the tests fail with "left running: in use by pid N". Observed on PR #4022 CI run 42382785972 job 128434087591 (2026-11-07): test_a_guest_that_powers_off_is_stopped_without_machine_stop, test_the_machine_is_stopped_after_a_run_whatever_state_it_was_in[running|stopped], test_a_zero_exit_stop_that_leaves_the_machine_running_is_still_an_error. The tests pass serially.
